description: The line plot compares the evaluation perplexity (PPL) of different methods as a function of the ratio of activated parameters. The x-axis, labeled 'Activated Parameters Ratio (%)', is a linear scale ranging from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis, labeled 'Eval PPL', is also a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line represents the 'Transformer' method, which remains constant at a PPL of approximately 11.6 across the x-axis. The gray line with square markers for 'Only MoHD FFN' starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.2 at 50%, then rises again to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The purple line with circle markers for 'Only MoHD ATTN' starts at about 11.5, rises significantly to around 14.0 at 25%. The blue line with cross markers for 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' begins at 11.5 and follows an upward trend to approximately 13.8 at 25%. The plot includes a legend at the top left corner, indicating the methods compared.
